name: Microsoft Power BI / Fabric (workspace roles)
status: PIM 100.142b (built, not live-proven): the workspace's users are READ through the Power BI ADMIN api (GetGroupUsersAsAdmin); the PIM group is ADDED through the Fabric workspace api (Add Workspace Role Assignment), where the engine identity is a workspace Admin (added once by Initialize-PimWorkloadPrereqs.ps1 -Workload PowerBI -AddEngineToWorkspaces). Add-only: a Remove row is refused, no DELETE is ever made.
permissionsNeeded: Fabric tenant settings > Admin API settings: 'Service principals can access read-only admin APIs' for a security group the engine identity is in (the READ)
Fabric tenant settings > Developer settings: 'Service principals can call Fabric public APIs'

The engine identity is Admin of every workspace a row names (Initialize-PimWorkloadPrereqs.ps1 -Workload PowerBI -AddEngineToWorkspaces, run once by a Fabric administrator signed in as a person; re-run when a new workspace is added)

prerequisites.tokenAdapter: auth=powerbi -> token for https://analysis.windows.net/powerbi/api (the READ); the assign operation names its own token resource https://api.fabric.microsoft.com (the ADD).
prerequisites.adminApiRead: PIM 100.142: the listing is a Power BI ADMIN api call (/v1.0/myorg/admin/groups/{workspace}/users). The admin api allows 200 requests per hour per tenant: one listing per workspace per run, and a 429 is waited out (Retry-After), never hammered.
prerequisites.fabricApiAdd: PIM 100.142b (owner 2026-10-14, 'One script run'): the Power BI admin api refuses its WRITE to a service principal (HTTP 401; Microsoft: the 'admin APIs used for updates' setting covers Fabric admin APIs only). The add goes through Fabric's Add Workspace Role Assignment, which supports managed identities when the caller is already a workspace Admin. A 401 / 403 there = POWERBI-ENGINE-NOT-IN-WORKSPACE.
prerequisites.scopeIsWorkspace: Row Scope = the Power BI workspace (group) id; the PIM group is added to that workspace with the role named by RoleName.
prerequisites.rolesAreFixed: Power BI workspace roles are a fixed enum (no list API) -- declared as a static roles array below.
prerequisites.addOnly: Owner 2026-10-13/14 ('Keep refusing for now'): this connector only ADDS. A Remove row is refused and reported exactly as before; the connector has no remove operation and no DELETE is ever made.
